name: Vaults of the Inquisition Normal trash hits a level 25 player as hard as in the June 2026 Normal log
contract: Vaults of the Inquisition (map 936) Normal creatures are level 59-60 and DestinyWeaver scales each blow to the viewer's level (finder entry 401, band 15-59). The Normal combat log of 2026-06-06 (level 25 group) shows median non-crit melee of 49 from Inquisitorial Torturer (162733). A class 1 creature of level 60 deals 118.3 per point of DamageModifier and DestinyWeaver's view of a level 25 player takes 0.345 of it: 40.8 per point. Creatures spawned in a Normal dungeon take CoA.CreatureScaling.Dungeon.Damage (x1.5) on top, which this fixture does not get (it is summoned by the player), so it hits for the log / 1.5: Torturer 0.801 * 40.8 = 32.7 (49 on a real spawn). Darkandle Brute (162763) is held at its Heroic blow at level 59 (166): 0.956 * 40.8 = 39.0 (58.5 on a real spawn). script_melee_hit_taken averages the creature's own blows through the done/taken bonuses and DestinyWeaver's view, before armor.

steps.label: CONTROL: the player is in Vaults of the Inquisition
Inquisitorial Torturer hits a level 25 player for about 32.7 before the dungeon x1.5 (49 as in the log)
Darkandle Brute hits a level 25 player for about 39 before the dungeon x1.5 (58.5, held at its Heroic blow at 59)
